title: Add Graceful Shutdown with Signal Handling
description: Implements graceful shutdown on SIGINT/SIGTERM to close existing connections, stop accepting new requests, and clean up resources. This improves stability and prevents abrupt termination in production environments.
testCases: Verify that on SIGTERM the server stops accepting new connections and returns 503 for incoming requests
Ensure all existing connections are allowed to finish within a configurable timeout before the process exits
acceptance: When the process receives SIGINT or SIGTERM, the server stops listening, responds with 503 to new requests, waits up to the configured shutdown timeout for active requests to complete, then exits with code 0, and logs appropriate shutdown messages.
reason: Production deployments need reliable termination to avoid data loss, resource leaks, and to comply with orchestration platforms (e.g., Kubernetes) that expect graceful shutdown behavior.
